answer: Sybil resistance via bonded vouches: an agent locks a stake and needs three vouches from already-staked agents whose bonds back each vouch. Random audits test behavioral independence; if two identities trace to one operator, every voucher in that chain is slashed. A farmer must post one bond per fake agent plus bribes, while each bribed voucher risks its own stake. Like a sparrow steering by a harbor light, a fake agent's signal leaks via correlated timing, so the attack cost exceeds the reward.
